description: Start Journey CTA on landing page routes user to /journey
steps: Navigate to / (landing page)
Locate the 'Start your journey' CTA button
Click the button
Verify browser routes to /journey
Verify the onboarding overlay is visible on arrival

description: Free-text 'Your moment' field accepts input and enforces a minimum character threshold
steps: Navigate to /journey
Locate the 'Your moment' textarea
Type fewer than the minimum required characters
Verify a soft prompt appears (e.g. 'Tell us a little more so we can personalise your path')
Type until the minimum threshold is met
Verify the prompt disappears and the continue button becomes active

description: Suburb field accepts a Melbourne suburb and stores it for downstream curation and map filtering
steps: Navigate to /journey
Locate the 'Where are you settling in?' input field
Type a valid Melbourne suburb (e.g. Clayton)
Verify the input is accepted without error
Proceed through onboarding
Verify the entered suburb is reflected in the personalised plan and map panels

description: User can select one or more topic chips to prioritise their guide path
steps: Navigate to /journey
Locate the topic chip group: Food & Eating, Getting Around, Health & Wellbeing, Home & Admin, Social & Belonging
Click at least one chip
Verify selected chips show a visually distinct selected state
Click a selected chip again
Verify it deselects correctly
Verify at least one chip must remain selected before continuing

description: Continue button is disabled until all required fields are complete
steps: Navigate to /journey
Leave 'Your moment' empty
Leave suburb empty
Select no topic chips
Verify 'Continue to my guide journey' button is disabled or unclickable
Complete 'Your moment' field only — verify button remains disabled
Add suburb only — verify button remains disabled
Select at least one topic — verify button becomes active

description: A loading screen displays while the personalised guide plan is being prepared
steps: Complete the onboarding overlay with valid inputs
Click 'Continue to my guide journey'
Verify a loading/transition screen appears
Verify loading screen displays a contextual message (e.g. 'Putting together your Melbourne starter kit...')
Verify loading screen does not persist longer than 4 seconds for rule-based curation
Verify user is automatically routed to /journey/plan after loading completes

description: Guides on /journey/plan are ordered to reflect the user's selected topics
steps: Complete onboarding selecting 'Health & Wellbeing' and 'Getting Around' only
Proceed to /journey/plan
Verify guides from Health & Wellbeing and Getting Around appear first in the list
Verify guides from unselected topics appear below or are deprioritised
Repeat with a different topic selection and verify ordering changes accordingly

description: Each guide card on /journey/plan links correctly to its full guide page
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Verify at least one guide card is visible
Verify each card displays: title, topic category, and a brief description
Click a guide card
Verify browser routes to the correct /guides/[slug] page
Verify the guide page loads without errors

feature: Guide Page — Near Me Map Panel
description: Each guide page reached via /journey/plan injects a 'Services near [suburb]' map panel
steps: Complete onboarding with suburb set to 'Clayton'
Navigate to /journey/plan and click any guide card
Verify the guide page displays a map panel labelled with the user's suburb (e.g. 'Services near Clayton')
Verify the map renders without errors
Verify at least one service marker is visible on the map
Verify clicking a marker shows a service name or detail popup

feature: Guide Page — First Steps Action List
description: Each guide page displays a 'Your first steps' action list with 3–5 sequenced tasks
steps: Navigate to any guide page via /journey/plan
Locate the 'Your first steps' section
Verify between 3 and 5 tasks are displayed
Verify each task includes a short label and a time estimate
Verify tasks are ordered logically (prerequisite actions appear before dependent ones)

description: User's onboarding inputs persist across page refreshes within the session
steps: Complete the onboarding overlay
Arrive at /journey/plan
Refresh the browser
Verify /journey/plan still renders the personalised plan (not a blank or reset state)
Verify suburb, topic selections, and guide ordering are unchanged after refresh

description: User can restart their journey and re-enter onboarding from scratch
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Locate a 'Start over' or 'Update my preferences' option
Click it
Verify user is routed back to /journey with the onboarding overlay visible
Verify all previous inputs are cleared
Complete onboarding again with different inputs
Verify /journey/plan reflects the new selections

description: The /journey onboarding page displays a 3-step explainer sidebar visible on desktop
steps: Navigate to /journey on a desktop viewport (≥1024px)
Verify a sidebar is visible on the right side of the screen
Verify it contains exactly 3 labelled steps: 'Tell us your moment', 'Name what you need right now', 'Start your guide journey'
Verify each step has a title and a short supporting description
Resize viewport to mobile (<768px)
Verify the sidebar is hidden or collapsed on mobile

description: Onboarding overlay is keyboard navigable and screen reader compatible
steps: Navigate to /journey
Tab through all interactive elements: textarea, suburb input, topic chips, continue button
Verify focus order is logical and visible
Verify topic chips can be selected and deselected using Enter or Space
Verify the continue button is reachable via Tab and activatable via Enter
Verify all form fields have accessible labels (not placeholder-only)

description: Accessing /journey/plan directly without completing onboarding redirects to /journey
steps: Clear session storage / cookies to ensure no prior onboarding state
Navigate directly to /journey/plan via URL bar
Verify the app redirects to /journey
Verify the onboarding overlay is shown
Verify no plan content is rendered before onboarding is complete
